{{Top|leg}}
"'''Robot Dance Mix'''" was an upbeat tune that was popular among the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] colonists of [[Ohma-D'un/Legends|Ohma-D'un]] around [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="TGF">[[Star Wars Episode I: The Gungan Frontier|''Star Wars'' Episode I: ''The Gungan Frontier'']]</ref> More than three [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] later, around [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], that tune still enjoyed popularity on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="DroidWorks">''[[Star Wars: DroidWorks]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Robot Dance Mix song was first heard in the ''[[Star Wars: DroidWorks]]'' video game. It could be heard when players activated a certain option in the game to show how their droid designs move, actually showing them dancing to the music. It was also played over the game's credits with droids dancing.<ref name="DroidWorks" /> The song was written by [[Clint Bajakian]], [[David Levison]], [[Michael Land]], [[Jeff Kliment]] and [[Larry the O]].<ref name="Manual">{{WebCite|url=https://oldgamesdownload.com/wp-content/uploads/Star_Wars_Droid_Works_Manual_Mac_EN.pdf|text=Star Wars: DroidWorks instruction manual|work=OldGamesDownload.com|archivedate=20210403125756}}</ref>
